given: two checklists with overlapping obligations of one item requirement, a late obligation within L, one past L, an item in two places and two kit instances
when: record one check; check the item in one place and one kit instance; invalidate the check
then: every on-time and late-within-L obligation of that item requirement is linked, nothing past L or in another place or kit instance is linked, and invalidation voids all links
notes: Language-neutral behavioral contract; runner implementation deferred until stack selection. Revised for draft SPEC amendment 6.0.0 (PR #254).
